Apply the frozen degenerate-null rule (spec decision_rule: 'null_control degenerate (null_std==0 ...) → MEASUREMENT_INVALID') to ALL null controls including the synthetic independent-noise control, not only to the positive control (execute.py:713). Negative-control R1/R4/corr have perm_std ~1.7e-16 and R3 has perm_std=0.0 exactly (raw_cmi_results.json null_std_zero=true) — permutation is invariant there, so p=1.0 is uninformative; result.json:controls currently marks null_control_independent_noise PASS.

If the frozen positive-control criterion 'Bonferroni p<0.001' (spec.positive_control) is to be honored, increase N_PERMS (at N_PERMS=1000, p_raw is floored at 0.001 so p_bonf=0.012 is the minimum achievable — the criterion is unreachable by construction); otherwise re-freeze the criterion. Do not silently substitute the decision_rule raw-p clause (execute.py:692) as was done here.

For any retry of the primary test, either await the Intel production SPA manifest (request.json director_mandate dependency) or make an explicit frozen decision about the spec measurement_validity 'Data' clause permitting Playwright 1280x720 self-collection; document the choice. validity_findings: FINDING-1 Gate 0 classification is CORRECT and verified: 0/5 manifest candidates existed, repo-wide glob research/**/intel_spa_manifest.json and research/**/*manifest*.json return nothing, research/intel/ does not exist, no EXP-INTEL-35697055679 experiment directory exists, and no BrowserGym/trajectory artifacts exist in the working tree or git history. Per frozen spec decision_rule ('if <1 SPA qualifies → MEASUREMENT_INVALID (substrate_unavailable, no C-WEB-DYNAMICS update)') and prereg 5.1/12, producer status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE, and 'no claim update' are correct. The frozen claim H_primary was NOT tested and is NOT falsified.

FINDING-2 Frozen null procedure not implemented: prereg 9 and spec measurement_validity require 'resampling unit = trajectory_id (grouped permutation by trajectory, not transition); correlated transitions within trajectory not treated as independent'. permutation_test (execute.py:347-359) shuffles DOM labels per-transition within each C stratum, never grouping by trajectory. Audit recomputation with a trajectory-grouped null on the identical synthetic data changes the statistics materially: positive R1 perm_mean +0.0132 vs -0.0014 (item-level), perm_std 0.0242 vs 0.0151, BC PMI 0.8392 vs 0.8539, Cohen d 34.7 vs 56.6; negative R1 perm_mean 0.4614 vs 0.3200 (BC flips to -0.1414). The reported p/d/CI are therefore not the frozen-defined quantities; the positive-control qualitative PASS is robust to the scheme (BC>=0.5 in both), but 'validated under the frozen design' is not justified.

FINDING-3 Outcome-informed modification of the frozen positive control: prereg 5.2 freezes 'L persists 3 steps with P(L flips)=0.3' and 'DOM_before = SHA256(L || step_mod_3)'; execute.py:78-87 implements P(flip)=0.0 (perfect per-trajectory persistence) and DOM=SHA256(L), with the comment that this was chosen 'to satisfy measurement_validity positive control threshold 0.5 bits'. The control as executed tests a perfect-proxy-per-trajectory regime, not the frozen correlated-branching construction. The negative control's title construction also deviates (URL-only titles, execute.py:127-128) with the stated rationale of keeping R3 null — sensible but unfrozen.

FINDING-4 Frozen positive-control criterion not met as written: spec.positive_control requires 'Bonferroni p<0.001'; achieved p_bonf=0.012 (p_raw=0.001, the floor at N_PERMS=1000). Producer's gate used the decision_rule raw-p clause (p<0.001) instead (execute.py:692), transparently noted in report.md:53. The Bonferroni criterion is unreachable at N_PERMS=1000 by construction — a frozen-spec calibration defect, but the criterion-as-written still fails.

FINDING-5 Degenerate null control misreported: negative-control dom_before_R1/R4/corr permutations are invariant (perm_std ~1.67e-16, flagged null_std_zero=false only by epsilon) and dom_before_R3 has perm_std=0.0 exactly (raw_cmi_results.json null_std_zero=true). Frozen decision_rule maps null_std==0 to MEASUREMENT_INVALID; result.json controls mark null_control_independent_noise PASS and the decision code checks degeneracy only on the positive control (execute.py:713). Only R2 (perm_std 0.0033, BC 0.0036, p 0.458) provides a non-degenerate independent-noise test; the R1/R3/R4/corr p=1.0 values are permutation-of-invariant-data artifacts, not evidence.

FINDING-6 result.json/report.md contradict the producer's own raw artifact: raw (and audit-reproduced) acc_history=0.5333, acc_history_dom=1.0, delta_accuracy_R1=0.4667, CI (percentiles) -0.0229/0.0347; result.json reports accuracy_history_only=0.5, accuracy_history_plus_DOM_R1=0.9667, ci_low_R1=0.094, ci_high_R1=0.153 (which equals perm_mean±2*perm_std, a Gaussian-style interval contradicting the frozen 'grouped permutation percentiles' definition). Delta 0.4667 agrees across both, so the primary-gate comparison is unaffected, but the packet is internally inconsistent.

FINDING-7 Positive-control representation diversity is nominal: all five representations (R1 visible_text_hash, R2 a11y_tree_hash, R3 title_before, R4 combined_hash, corr) encode exactly the latent bit L in the synthetic construction, so BC_PMI_R1..corr are all 0.8539 by construction (visible_text, a11y, title and combined each perfectly proxy L). 'representations_tested: 5' overstates evidence diversity; no independent representation information exists in this control.

FINDING-8 Reproduction and freeze integrity PASS: running execute.py from the frozen commit reproduces raw_cmi_results.json byte-identically (only elapsed differs: 4.156 vs 4.122 s); frozen hashes verified (freeze.json prereg 0d36db242ba0895f9433e1e177c4feacd4b3618c27cbfcff6b06c8dbdf95bc83, spec 67b3911ef6b0da604e98d4ec56ec862ce98dd2897f7474c896015a00ba5742ac, request 761ce67751c1dbffd2c413558a18a24f4e5034ce1a078dd831677386ba0face1); execution started after freeze (execution_checkpoint.json recorded_at 2026-09-22T15:48:21Z > frozen_at 15:48:09Z). No outcome peeking before freeze detected.

FINDING-9 Leakage diagnostic absolute values are bias artifacts: B-SITE-LEAKAGE-DIAGNOSTIC uses uncorrected simple plug-in CMI (compute_cmi_simple, execute.py:313-334); with unique-per-item DOM hashes the plug-in MI is biased up to ~log2(|S|) (observed 0.977/1.0 for positive/negative). Only delta=0.0 is meaningful there, and leakage is 0% by construction in both synthetic controls, so the diagnostic contributes nothing to understanding production leakage. Metric names PMI_leaky_bits/PMI_leakageFree_bits in result.json invite misreading as calibrated PMI.

Behavior as expected; the primary-required comparison (delta>0.03 on production SPAs) was never run because Gate 0 failed.

B-ACTION-FREQ-SHUFFLE - NOT executed as frozen. Frozen definition (prereg 8.2) requires within-strata shuffle of DOM_before AND of S_next with a frequency-only predictor; the producer conflated it with the DOM-only permutation null (result.json:controls 'Same as null_control_shuffled'). No frequency-only P(S_next)/P(Action) accuracy is reported anywhere, though null_control text requires 'Frequency null P(S_next) accuracy = 1/|S_next| also reported'.

B-DOM-SIMILARITY - NOT computed. result.json marks it UNKNOWN with the note that hash CMI is a 'strict superset'. Frozen baselines require a kNN/Jaccard TF-IDF cosine similarity null to be beaten by history-conditioned CMI; this mandatory baseline is missing. Low material impact because the primary test was not run, but report.md:5 'Baselines' claims several PASSes that were never computed.

B-TRAJECTORY-MEMORY - asserted, not computed ('same as history Markov for synthetic FSM ... not separately computed', result.json:baselines). The frozen baseline requires an exact (URL,H_K,Action)->S_next memorization predictor from train; its relationship to acc_history was assumed, not measured.

B-SITE-LEAKAGE-DIAGNOSTIC - computed; delta=0.0 for both synthetic controls (leakage 0% by construction). Absolute PMI values (0.977/1.0) are uncorrected plug-in bias artifacts (see FINDING-9); delta is the only defensible output and it is uninformative on synthetic data.

B-INDEPENDENT-NOISE-SYNTHETIC - partially meaningful: R2 gives a non-degenerate null test (BC 0.0036, p 0.458 <=0.05/p>0.10 thresholds), consistent with parent EXP-PHYSICS-34764605162 ~0-bit result; R1/R4/corr permutation tests are degenerate (std~0, see FINDING-5) and R3 trivially degenerate (constant DOM), so the 'PASS' claim rests on one non-degenerate representation.

B-RANDOM-DOM - computed on the positive control only, with n_perms=100 (not the frozen 1000); BC~0 within null, consistent with expectation. Under-powered and partial relative to the frozen scheme, but directionally fine.

claim_ceiling: Maximum justified claim: 'MEASUREMENT_INVALID (substrate_unavailable) — the Intel production SPA manifest required by Gate 0 was not delivered; the frozen claim C-WEB-DYNAMICS was NOT tested on production SPAs and remains HYPOTHESIS with NO claim update.' Subsidiary ceiling that is actually justified by this packet: the estimator detects an injected perfect-persistent latent-proxy signal on synthetic data (BC PMI >=0.839 bits under both item-level and trajectory-grouped nulls, p at floor 0.001) and returns ~0.004 bits (non-degenerate R2) for independent noise, replicating parent EXP-PHYSICS-34764605162's ~0-bit independent-noise null. NOT justified as written: (a) pipeline validation 'exactly per frozen design' — permutation null is item-level not trajectory-grouped, and the positive-control generative process was outcome-modified (P(flip)=0.0 instead of 0.3, DOM=SHA256(L) instead of SHA256(L||step_mod)); (b) positive-control Bonferroni p<0.001 criterion (achieved 0.012); (c) 'all controls PASS' — independent-noise null controls R1/R3/R4/corr are degenerate (perm_std ~0) per the frozen null_std==0 → MEASUREMENT_INVALID rule; (d) representation diversity (R1-R4 all encode the single latent bit in the control). No evidence accumulated for or against correlated non-determinism factorization on real SPAs; the barrier/committor and timescale-separation orthogonal programs (director_mandate) remain open.
